svg.title: What I work with
svg.desc: Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Rust, Kotlin. Frameworks and libraries: Next.js, React, Svelte, Vue, Tailwind CSS, Base UI, Tauri, Hono, FastAPI, Drizzle ORM. Data: PostgreSQL, SQLite, MySQL, MariaDB, MongoDB, Redis. Infrastructure and self-hosting: Docker, Linux, Proxmox, Tailscale, GitHub Actions, Coolify, Traefik, Mailcow, Borgmatic. Hosting and services: Cloudflare (Workers, Pages, R2 and D1), Netcup, Hetzner, Hostinger, Namecheap, Resend, Stripe. AI: Anthropic, OpenAI, MiniMax, OpenRouter, ElevenLabs, MCP.
